_comment: Metric registry for the 'rankings' series: one Top-N countdown video per metric (NOT one video per chapter -- confirmed with the user). Live metrics are fetched fresh each run via scripts/fetch_rankings_stats.py (World Bank public API, bulk country=all calls, entries older than MAX_AGE_YEARS relative to the freshest available year are dropped before ranking). Static metrics have no free live API and are read from config/rankings_static.json (curated real snapshots, refreshed manually -- see that file's _comment for the refresh cadence). 'chapter' is informational only (groups metrics for readability); it does NOT define video boundaries. 'display_label' (when present) is what's shown/spoken as the ranking's name -- distinct from 'label' (the raw index name used to look up units/formatting) for metrics whose raw name reads backwards as a title (e.g. a 'Corruption Perceptions Index' countdown with the cleanest country at #1 reads as 'most corrupt' if titled literally). 'note' (when present) is spoken in the narration's opening line in addition to being printed in the footer, since a viewer skimming past the first couple seconds (or not reading on-screen text at all) should still get the caveat -- audio reaches more of the audience than any on-screen text does. 'tone' (when present) overrides the default 'energetic countdown' framing sent to GPT. Rotation order below is the fixed round-robin sequence scripts/generate_rankings_script.py walks through, day by day -- reordering this list changes which metric posts on which day, so treat it as append-only once the series is live (add new metrics at the end). literacy_rate was removed 2026-09-21: even with the age filter, its top ranks are structurally unstable (most countries near-universal literacy stop measuring it at all, so the field is whichever handful of countries still bother to survey -- see project memory for the fuller reasoning).
